[*]Chapter 1 Ending Expansion:

notes.title: The first wave of updates for Sunset Hill is here! With a surprise discount~
notes.notes:
Dear beloved players:

We are thrilled to announce that "Sunset Hills" has live at TGS2024. Visit us at Hall 9, Indie Games Section, Booth 09-W62 to experience the magic firsthand. 

Don't be disheartened if you can't make it in person; we've prepared a historical low discount for Sunset Hills! Invite your good friends to enjoy this weekend to the fullest!ːSpeech_Loveː

Our team is dedicated to refining and expanding the game. This update marks the first wave of improvements, with more to follow alongside the Japanese release. Stay tuned for more updates!

[h1]Bugs Fixes Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect grey dot display on options.
[*] Resolved movement issue in the orphanage.
[*] Fixed the issue with accepting Ferruccio's costume quest.
[*] Adjusted spin wheel settings for long-press rotation.
[*] Addressed positioning problems in bookstore dialogues.
[*] Corrected overlapping item shadows.
[*] Fixed animation errors when placing items in the backpack.
[*] Corrected avatar display issues at the observation deck.
[*] Fixed camera glitch transitioning from the main menu to the commercial street.
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay Content Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Map bubbles at the bus stop will remain visible until collected.
[*] Set Ferruccio's family TV to retain channels, allowing players to customize their experience with synchronized music and animation.
[*] Removed borderless mode from the main menu.
[/list]
These updates are now live, so we invite both new and returning players to explore the changes. Enjoy a relaxing gaming journey with us and remember, Nico stands by your side!ːtobdogː

We value the feedback received since launch and have held numerous internal meetings to address player concerns. Your insights drive us to continuously improve, ensuring we offer the ultimate experience for all dog lovers. We are listening and learning from you.

Rest assured, we are committed to enhancing the game while staying true to our vision. Our team is working tirelessly to polish upcoming chapters and optimize the gaming experience. We kindly ask for your continued support and trust. Your feedback is crucial to our growth, and we are grateful for your patience and constructive criticism. Together, we will create even more amazing adventures.

Thank you for your unwavering support!ːSpeech_Loveː

notes.title: A Message from Nico-Addressing Your Concerns
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

I want to personally thank you all for your feedback on Sunset Hills—your thoughts and experiences are incredibly valuable to us. I’ve noticed some concerns about the game feeling incomplete, and I’d like to offer some clarification.

Sunset Hills is designed as a road movie, with each chapter being an independent and complete story. For experienced players, the current game content offers an estimated 6 to 8 hours of gameplay, filled with rich narratives and engaging puzzles.

As we continue to improve Sunset Hills, we’ll keep you updated with any new developments or content.

Thank you for your patience, understanding, and continued support. 

Warm regards,
Nico

notes.title: Sunset Hills is going to be live on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Sunset Hills is going to be live on Kickstarter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550174/cb901325f45ea66ffe2f987cebe0cba24d7a743d.png[/img]

[b]Our Plan[/b]
We're targeting a Q3 2024 release for our game on PC via Steam and Nintendo Switch with versions for Android and iOS to follow. While releases across these platforms may not happen simultaneously, we are committed to ensuring that backers receive their copy of the game as soon as it becomes available on their selected platform.

[b]Why Kickstarter?[/b]
The game is almost done, but as the saying goes in game development: "the last 20% is 80% of the work!" We still have a lot to do-polishing, audio design, balancing, localization, and porting all of which are costly. Having developed this game for years without the support of a publisher or marketing team, we've decided to launch a Kickstarter campaign. This will allow our fantastic community and supporters to help us cross the finish line ourselves, Every backer plays a crucial role in helping us create something truly special!

Sunset Hills will be officially launched on Kickstarter soon.

Please click“Notify me on launch” button to get information as soon as the campaign begins
